sectionDescriptions.editors: Editors used by “Edit” / “Open With” in the file browser.
sectionDescriptions.data: Back up, restore, and reset your data.

colorTheme.label: Color Theme
colorTheme.description: Switch between the dark and softer grey light interface

accent.label: Accent Color
accent.description: Used for buttons, links, and active states

language.label: Language
language.description: Language used for menus, labels, and messages

font.label: Interface Font
font.description: Font for menus, labels, and panels

monoFont.label: Interface Monospace Font
monoFont.description: Font for paths, permissions, and code (not the terminal)

copyOnSelect.label: Copy on Select
copyOnSelect.description: Copy highlighted text to the clipboard automatically

pasteButton.label: Paste Button
pasteButton.description: Mouse button that pastes the clipboard into the terminal

scrollback.label: Scrollback Buffer
scrollback.description: Number of lines to keep in history (500–100,000)

history.note: Changes apply to open terminals immediately.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Whether the browser shows This PC beside the remote files (also switchable from the browser header)

doubleClick.label: Double-click a File
doubleClick.description: What happens when you double-click a file in the browser

explorer.note: Opening falls back to downloading when no editor is configured (see Editors).

export.label: Export encrypted backup
export.description: Save all hosts, groups, snippets, settings, and stored credentials to a single password-protected file.

import.label: Import backup
import.description: Restore from a backup file. This replaces all current data and restarts anySCP.

clear.label: Clear all data
clear.description: Permanently delete every saved host, group, connection history entry, snippet, port-forward rule, and S3 connection — along with their stored credentials and all app preferences. anySCP restarts at first-launch state. This can’t be undone.

backupModal.exportIntro: Choose a password to encrypt the backup. You’ll need it to restore — there’s no way to recover the data without it.
backupModal.importIntro: Enter the password this backup was created with. Importing replaces all current data and restarts anySCP.

resetModal.title: Clear all data?
resetModal.body: This permanently deletes all saved hosts, groups, history, snippets, port-forward rules, S3 connections, stored credentials, and preferences. anySCP will restart fresh. This action cannot be undone.
resetModal.failed: Couldn’t clear data. Please try again.

editors.empty: No editors configured. Scan for installed editors, or add one manually.
editors.hint: The starred editor is used by “Edit”; the rest appear under “Open With”.
editors.noneFound: No editors found on this computer.
editors.allAdded: All detected editors are already added.

addEditor.title: Add Editor
addEditor.name: Name
addEditor.argsHint: Use {path} where the file should go. If omitted, it's added at the end.

about.tagline: A modern desktop client for SSH, SFTP, and S3

repository.label: Repository
repository.description: Source code, issues, and releases on GitHub

auto.label: Automatic Updates
auto.description: Download and install updates in the background, applied on the next launch
